question_text: Outline the difference between a Python class attribute and an instance attribute when recording a total count.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A class attribute belongs to the class and can be shared/accessed through it. Each instance attribute is stored as part of a particular object’s state, so individual objects can hold different values.
partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
common_errors: Assigning self.count may create an instance attribute that shadows the class attribute.
